items.headline: HarnessAPI: A Skill-First Framework for Unified Streaming APIs and MCP Tools
items.summary:

Abstract: Every Python function deployed as an LLM tool must today exist in two forms: an HTTP endpoint for human-facing clients and CI pipelines, and an MCP tool registration for agent runtimes such as Claude and Cursor.
